home.story.title: We started with a 12-kilo roaster in Moda.
home.story.text: Since 2019 we have bought our beans directly from farmers or through importers we trust. We taste every new harvest at the cupping table first and roast until we find the profile that expresses it best. Then we roast small batches to order and ship them out.
